items.title: Paul Shaffer interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, August 24, 2023
items.q: Will Calhoun on drums and he said you’ve got to get Jamaaladeen Tacuma on bass, whom I was already familiar with. These two guys and Tisziji and myself

ctx.x: And something you pointed out, that you were an apprentice, and that idea of having a mentor is not around as much as it used to be so it’s fortunate that that happened for you.

It sure is. And he continues to be a mentor this guy, fascinated by him. Now this latest record that we just recorded and we’re kind of dealing with now at the stage of now how do we finish it exactly. But he’s at the point now where we’ve got two great musicians. He said to me, “Get me, you know, instead of the guys I normally play with, who do you think I should play with?” And so I got the great Will Calhoun on drums who you may know from playing with the group now whose name escapes me. Excuse me? Yes.…
Wow did it seem obvious that you needed to go to the United States eventually?
